title: Raa and laam: heavy or light?: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 7 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Raa and laam rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 7. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Raa with sukoon: look before it
points: But heavy if an isti'la letter follows in the word (مِرْصَادًا)

panels.title: The laam in the Name Allah
points: After fathah or dammah: heavy (هُوَ ٱللَّهُ)

head: Not this
This
rows: ٱمْرِئٍ (80:37) with a heavy raa because of the alif
The raa has a kasrah: light

questions.a: فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ heavy (fathah); ٱمْرِئٍ light (kasrah); فِرْعَوْنَ light (sukoon after kasrah, no isti'la after).

questions.q: Raa audit (pupil PDF): mark every raa in 'Abasa 80:34 to 42 H or L with a reason. Today's rota group recites 80:25 to 33.
questions.a: ٱلْمَرْءُ H (sukoon after fathah); ٱمْرِئٍ L (kasrah); مُّسْفِرَةٌ H (fathah); مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ H (fathah); غَبَرَةٌ H; تَرْهَقُهَا H; قَتَرَةٌ H; ٱلْكَفَرَةُ H; ٱلْفَجَرَةُ H.

questions.q: Extend: find the Name Allah in Al-Ikhlas and say heavy or light.
questions.a: Heavy both times (112:1 after fathah; 112:2 starting).

questions.q: Stretch: why is the raa in مِرْصَادًا heavy, though a kasrah comes before?
questions.a: An isti'la letter (ص) follows the raa in the same word.
A) heavy: sukoon after fathah. The raa has sukoon and the taa before it has fathah, so heavy.

questions.q: Think again: Raa and laam are light letters, yet sometimes we say them heavy. How can one letter be both?
questions.a: They are not isti'la letters, so their weight depends on the vowels around them.
